paper_title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
role: Trajectory configuration and capability inventory
lessons: ["Separate counts from boolean capability fields.","Explain dynamic constraints on configuration values."]
cautions: ["Define cross versus dash explicitly.","Do not present maxima as observed counts."]

lessons: ["Use role-based shading to distinguish baseline and selected configuration.","Keep the selection objective explicit in multi-objective experiments."]
cautions: ["Add textual baseline/selected labels so color is not the only role cue.","Do not call the pale fills partially transparent: extracted fill opacity is 1.0."]

paper_title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
role: Memory/runtime scaling with hardware count and failure outcomes
lessons: ["Reserve explicit outcome tokens for resource failures.","Place GPU count, precision, and problem size alongside timing and memory."]
cautions: ["Do not replace OOM with zero or a generic dash.","State whether added optimizations are cumulative or independent, and clarify per-GPU versus total memory."]

lessons: ["Use a configuration table rather than a timeline when precise settings matter.","Keep data-processing semantics with numeric settings."]
cautions: ["Do not total stage quantities as if they were independent dataset counts.","Expand task abbreviations when the table must stand alone."]

cautions: ["Do not copy a legend for notation absent from the displayed table.","Define volume units and unique samples versus exposures."]

role: Runtime comparison with reported plus/minus variation
lessons: ["Keep value and uncertainty aligned and give them compatible precision.","Require uncertainty type and sample count in a new caption or note."]
cautions: ["Do not invent that the plus/minus term is standard deviation.","Do not infer significance from non-overlapping unclassified plus/minus terms."]

lessons: ["Attach benchmark eligibility and contamination/exposure notes to omitted values.","Retain metric direction independently for each column."]

cautions: ["Define the aggregate Avg. calculation.","Do not equate fewer parameters with measured lower latency."]

lessons: ["Use category stubs and section rules for long benchmark lists.","Require a declared rounding and tie policy before styling winners."]
cautions: ["Do not copy differing ranks for equal displayed values without explaining hidden precision.","Do not adopt unnecessary downscaling as a design default."]
